entities.summary: Hubert Wolf is a German church historian and professor at the University of Münster. He was awarded a Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize in 2003. In 2006, he was awarded the Gutenberg Prize of the International Gutenberg Society and the City of Mainz.
